population_one_line: Adult Staphylococcus aureus bacteraemia, population-based 10 hospitals Skåne Sweden
ttp_reported: Median TTP 8.7h (IQR 7.7-10.6) for IE vs 13.3h (IQR 10.5-16.5) for non-IE; cutpoint 13h
outcome_one_line: TTP for IE: sensitivity 100% (91-100), specificity 52% (47-57); AUC 0.83 (0.78-0.88); validation cohort AUC 0.84 (0.79-0.89). 30-day mortality 24% IE vs 19% non-IE
notes: Primary outcome is IE prediction; also reports 30/90-day mortality. Quantitative TTP-outcome assoc via AUC/sens/spec/cutpoint.

population_one_line: Adult patients with fatal outcome and blood cultures taken within 7 days of death, single Turkish center
outcome_one_line: Descriptive analysis of bacteremia etiology and appropriate antimicrobial therapy in fatal cases
notes: Turkish-language article. No TTP measurement. Descriptive only.

population_one_line: Adult MRSA bacteremia, matched cohort (ceftaroline vs vancomycin), San Diego VA
ttp_reported: Not reported (duration of bacteremia in days reported, not TTP of blood culture)
outcome_one_line: Median duration of bacteremia 4 vs 3 days (p=0.806); 30-day all-cause mortality not different
notes: Conference abstract (IDWeek 2021), n=15/group, no TTP measured. Wrong design + no_ttp.

population_one_line: Adult allo-HSCT recipients with preengraftment VRE bacteremia, MSKCC
ttp_reported: Not reported (duration of VREB in days reported)
outcome_one_line: Empiric vs directed VRE therapy outcomes; 30-day mortality, recurrence reported but no TTP analysis
notes: No TTP of blood culture measured/analyzed.

population_one_line: Prospective multicenter cohort of Staphylococcus aureus bacteremia, Korea (KIND study group)
ttp_reported: Not reported; study analyzes duration of bacteremia (time-to-clearance), not TTP of blood culture
outcome_one_line: Defines persistent bacteremia by duration of positive blood cultures and association with in-hospital mortality
notes: Duration of bacteremia (time to negative culture) is a different concept than TTP (incubation time to flag positive). No TTP measured.

population_one_line: Adults with Candida endocarditis, multicenter retrospective letter, 4 academic centers
ttp_reported: Mean time from symptom onset to blood culture positivity 21.8 days (not TTP from incubation to flag); 50% had prior negative blood culture
outcome_one_line: Descriptive only - no TTP-outcome quantitative association reported
notes: Letter to the Editor with small case series. Reports time-from-symptom-to-positivity, not TTP of culture; descriptive only with no quantitative TTP-outcome association.

population_one_line: Patients with acute cholangitis (severe n=37, moderate n=231) undergoing ERCP, single Japanese center
ttp_reported: Group A (severe): 13 within 12h, 2 in 12-24h; Group B (moderate): 10 within 12h, 11 in 12-24h (descriptive only)
outcome_one_line: Mortality 4/37 severe vs 0 attributable in moderate; TTP described but not associated with outcome quantitatively
notes: Conference poster abstract (J Gastroenterol Hepatol 2011 Suppl 5). TTP given as descriptive frequencies by group, no quantitative TTP-outcome association reported. Also wrong_design (abstract).

population_one_line: Adult earthquake victims admitted to ICU after 2023 Türkiye earthquake, multicenter
ttp_reported: Not reported. 'Timing of culture positivity' refers to onset (within 72h vs after 72h of ICU admission) for any culture source, not TTP of blood culture incubation
outcome_one_line: Predictors of microbiologically proven infection (any site); no TTP-outcome analysis for BSI
notes: Cultures include all sites (not BSI-specific). 'Time to positivity' refers to ICU-stay timing of infection onset, not blood culture TTP. No TTP as defined.

population_one_line: Adult candidemia, prospective multicenter Australia 8 institutions over 12 months
outcome_one_line: 30-day mortality 31%; risk predictive model for mortality using age, ICU, organ dysfunction, surgery, hematologic malignancy, source, antibiotic days
notes: Candidemia mortality predictive model paper; TTP not measured/analyzed. (TTP from same dataset reported separately in Keighley2023.)

population_one_line: Adult candidemia episodes, prospective multicenter Australia/NZ Mycoses Interest Group 29 sites 2014-2015
ttp_reported: Median TTP 48h (IQR 33-65); species-specific medians: C. albicans 49h, C. glabrata 55h, C. tropicalis 27h, P. kudriavzevii 33h, C. parapsilosis 48h
outcome_one_line: Each day increase in TTP multiplies OR for 30-day survival by 1.32 (95%CI 1.06-1.69); shorter TTP -> higher mortality (1-day TTP 37% mortality vs 5-day TTP 11%)
notes: Direct TTP-mortality OR with CI reported; per-day analysis.
